title: Rational ordinary Frobenius cube components
statement: Fix D,C,E,n,hn and S:SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn as in [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. At the rational coefficient stage let L be the Frobenius comparisons satisfying the corresponding normalization of [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]. For the ordinary direct exchange and direct-image composition transformations, the component cube equation c_F(K) α(P_in K)=P_out(α(K)) c_G(K) holds for every object K. Here the iterated comparisons and the actual transformations are precisely those of [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]; use all separatedness, finite-type, finite-Tor, lattice and witnessed-origin restrictions specified there. This assertion is only the ordinary underlying-category part, without fixed-pair equations or the representative-change intertwining conclusions.

proof.text:
Relabel the source k-structures by geometric Frobenius. The underlying sites,
units and counits are unchanged. Apply square naturality of fix-lem-exchanges to the
Frobenius cube for exchange, and vertical pasting for composition. Substitute the
normalized pullback compositors and their adjunction mates, retaining all coefficient
comparison maps. Rationalization preserves the equality; for the common stage choose
one finite coefficient field for the finite diagram and cancel intermediate scalar
comparisons using their tower cocycle. No inverse to the exchange is used.

lean.statement: theorem rational_ordinary_cubes (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum) (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (L : Comparisons S.higher.rational (fun X : Models D ↦ sfWeilFrobeniusPullback D C.l C.different X.obj E)) (hL : rationalNormalized D C E S.higher L) : (∀ (Q : ModelSquare D) [IsSeparated Q.f.hom.left] [IsSeparated Q.f'.hom.left] [IsSeparated Q.g.hom.left] [IsSeparated Q.g'.hom.left], ∀ K, ((iterated (L.direct Q.f) (L.pull Q.g))).hom.app K ≫ ((directExchange S.higher.rational (S.higher.rationalExchange Q.fiber))).app ((sfWeilFrobeniusPullback D C.l C.different Q.X.obj E).obj K) = (sfWeilFrobeniusPullback D C.l C.different Q.Y'.obj E).map (((directExchange S.higher.rational (S.higher.rationalExchange Q.fiber))).app K) ≫ ((iterated (L.pull Q.g') (L.direct Q.f'))).hom.app K) ∧ (∀ {X Y Z : Models D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [IsSeparated h.hom.left], ∀ K, ((iterated (L.direct f) (L.direct h))).hom.app K ≫ ((directComposition S.higher.rational f h).hom).app ((sfWeilFrobeniusPullback D C.l C.different X.obj E).obj K) = (sfWeilFrobeniusPullback D C.l C.different Z.obj E).map (((directComposition S.higher.rational f h).hom).app K) ≫ ((L.direct (f ≫ h))).hom.app K)
